title: pvRestartedSimSpyPlotReader
body:
## pvRestartedSimSpyPlotReader

Reads a CTH (Spy Plot) simulation that was restarted, through a metadata file (.spcth-timeseries) listing the output file sets of each restart, so the sets behave as one continuous time series. Output port 0 is the volume data (hierarchical blocks with cell-centred arrays such as material volume fractions), port 1 the tracers and port 2 the markers; select a port with {"node": id, "port": n}. Use pvSpyPlotReader for a single .spcth case and pvspcthhistoryreader for history files.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- FileName must name the restart metadata file, not one of the individual .spcth case files.
- Fields are cell-centred; convert with cellToPoint before operations that need point data.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `RestartedSimSpyPlotReader`. Identity: `sources/SPCTHRestartReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrayStatus` | Names of the cell-centred arrays to load from the Spy Plot files (for example material volume fractions, masses, pressure or velocity components). Arrays not listed are absent from the output; listing fewer reduces memory and read time. The available names come from the files themselves. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `DistributeFiles` | In parallel mode, if this property is set to 1, the reader will distribute files or blocks. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DownConvertVolumeFraction` | If this property is set to 0, the type of the volume fraction is float; is set to 1, the type is unsigned char. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FileName` | This points to a special metadata file that lists the output files for each restart. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `GenerateActiveBlockArray` | If this property is set to 1, a cell array will be generated that stores the active status of a block. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateBlockIdArray` | If this property is set to 1, a cell array will be generated that stores a unique blockId for each block. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateLevelArray` | If this property is set to 1, a cell array will be generated that stores the level of each block. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateMarkers` | If this property is set to 1, a second output will be created using the markers data stored in the file. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateTracers` | If this property is set to 1, a cell array will be generated that stores the coordinates of any tracers. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UseMetaFile` | This hidden property must always be set to 1 for this proxy to work. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": 3,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvRestartedSimSpyPlotReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
